name: ai-game-development-pipeline
description: Evidence-driven AI game development lab and production pipeline by By JTT

scripts.validate: node tools/validate-repo.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const mp='registry/ai-game-media-systems.v1.json';const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(mp));m.entries[0].entry_id='system.unity.ai-first-party';m.entries[1].benchmark_id='bench.missing.cross-shard';const u=m.entries.find(e=>e.entry_id==='asset.unirig');u.source_revisions.code_commit='0000000000000000000000000000000000000000';const c=m.entries.find(e=>e.entry_id==='voice.chatterbox');c.execution_status='EXECUTED';fs.writeFileSync(mp,JSON.stringify(m,null,2));const ip='registry/ai-game-dev-registry.v1.json';const i=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(ip));i.shards.find(s=>s.path===i.policy_shard).namespace='media';fs.writeFileSync(ip,JSON.stringify(i,null,2));" && node tools/validate-registry-shards.mjs && node tools/validate-github-config.mjs && npm run test:governor && npm run test:control-plane-freshness
